story.title: Our Love Story
story.subtitle: How two serendipitous paths aligned into one forever journey
paragraphs: It all started on a crisp autumn evening at a cozy corner café in the heart of the city. What was intended as a brief 30-minute coffee catch-up turned into three hours of nonstop conversations about books, dreams, old melodies, and shared aspirations.
Over four years of adventures—from spontaneous weekend road trips to cheering each other through milestones—we discovered our best friend and true confidant in each other.
Now, we are overjoyed to begin our next chapter and take our sacred vows surrounded by the warmth, blessings, and love of our nearest and dearest.
story.quote: "In all the world, there is no heart for me like yours. In all the world, there is no love for you like mine."
